reviews.title: Fantastic RAM, works great with AMD 9950x and X870E
reviews.comment:
Purchased the 6400MT kit (2x48GB) for use with a AMD 9950x workstation I use for development, and so far it's been rock solid stable at 6400MT on my Asus STRIX X870E-E motherboard. Only thing is I had to BIOS update via USB first for it to post, but since then it's been fantastic.
Would totally purchase again, and GSkill kicked it out of the park like always!
reviews.author: riptide_wave

reviews.title: Gskill does it again
reviews.comment: Great ram, not a whole lot to say. Looks great, performs well. Is also very short in height at that, for anyone who is using a cpu cooler with no a lot of clearance. Only issue is that this ram is fairly new at the time of writing this so make sure your motherboard is compatible. Talking to u ASUS. Highly recommend tho.
reviews.author: Jane Marie Helms

reviews.title: Great kit if you need a lot of RAM
reviews.comment: Using this kit with an MSI Tomahawk X870 board and Ryzen 9800X3D. Works flawlessly and booted up with XMP settings right away.
reviews.author: Howard J.

reviews.title: 4 sticks on MSI z790 MEG how I get to achieve 5400Mt/s
reviews.comment: I bought 4 RAM modules, and as you may know, the memory controller can be tricky when using all 4 slots. With this motherboard, I managed to get them running at 5400 MT/s without any stability issues using Memory Try It! at CL38. I had read elsewhere that it's possible to reach 5600 MT/s with the same setup, but I didn’t have any luck with that configuration. I'm using a 14900K, so maybe in the future I’ll try pushing the memory further — but so far, this is the fastest I’ve been able to achieve.
